witness_A.viewpoint: close by, inside, a few metres away
witness_A.statement: I saw a man in a red shirt pointing a gun at a man in a blue hoodie. The man in the hoodie ran into the counter and collected the money. He then ran away. The man in the red shirt walked to the cashier and kept handing money to the man in the blue hoodie. A person who was just nearby operated the cash register and collected the money.

witness_B.viewpoint: far away, looking in from outside
witness_B.statement: I saw a man who robbed the place run into the counter and point a gun at the man in red. I'm pretty sure the robber raised the gun from time to time to threaten the man in red. The man in white clothes walked to the cashier and operated the cash register, keeping handing money to the man in blue. I'm not sure if the person nearby operated the cash register or ran away.

witness_C.statement: I saw a man who ran into the counter and raised a gun from time to time to threaten the man in red. The man in red walked to the cashier and kept handing money to the man in blue. I think a person nearby operated and collected the money. I'm pretty sure the weapon was a knife.
